method: Full reading of all four English essays and all 351 frozen Chinese source blocks. Compared argument, supporting scenes, interpretive qualifications, names, edition notes, and metadata. Original independent English organization retained, not forced into Chinese paragraph alignment. Final requested change re-read after regeneration.
changes: Article 4 block 20: removed unverified broken-weapons and setting-down-a-bowl camera details; retained the contrast between the gathering, emptied cave, and Wukong departing in remembered history.
findings: All four main arguments and necessary narrative context retained; shorter English is an independent essay, not a partial-translation placeholder.
No claim that missing Wukong memory means the Destined One has no will; two possible completions and circlet-as-purpose remain readings, not game mechanics.
Yellowbrow argument no longer relies on an unverified physical blockade of retreat; preserves manipulation of circumstances and methodological criticism.
Erlang disclosure and first-cycle ending/new-cycle perk distinction retained.
limits: No full playthrough or frame-by-frame viewing of ending animations in this review; source audit limits retained.
Community transcriptions are not official publications; scene interpretation is distinguished from verified dialogue and original-novel text.
